question: Train a random forest regressor (n_estimators=100, random_state=42) to predict patient age from DNA methylation levels (beta values) and select the top 20 features by importance.

files.eval_guideline: At least 18 of the 20 reported feature names must be present in the reference set; importance scores for matched features must agree within 10% relative absolute error; column order and naming may differ.
files.match_reasoning: Both files have the identical filename top_20_features.csv and CSV format. Their paths identify the same task, and the filename corresponds directly to the requested top 20 methylation features ranked by random forest importance.

parameters.question: Align feature-name and importance columns despite differing names or order. Require at least 18 of the 20 reported feature names to occur in the reference set, and require importance scores for matched features to have absolute error no greater than 10% of the reference magnitude.

files.strategy_reasoning: The guideline explicitly requires record-level matching of feature names and importance scores, overriding the stochastic model-fitting default. Approximate comparison supports column and row alignment while applying the required feature overlap and 10% relative error criteria.

align_plan.reasoning: Both tables contain one feature per row, so no transpose is needed. Map Feature and Importance directly and exclude the candidate-only Rank and Pearson_r_with_Age columns. Match rows by the unique Feature identifier because ranking differs between tables. The top-20 task makes row order sensitive; preserve the existing descending importance order without pre-sorting. Compare importance scores for matched features using the stated 10% relative error tolerance and require at least 18 shared feature names. Structural alignment cannot correct numerical discrepancies.

column_configs.name: Importance
column_configs.reasoning: Importance is float64 and is the critical measured output. For each matched feature, require abs(candidate - reference) / abs(reference) <= 0.10, following the explicit 10% relative error guideline. Correlation would not ensure agreement of individual scores.

comparison_plan.overall_reasoning: Compare Importance for features aligned by Feature, excluding Feature from column_configs. Separately verify that at least 18 of the 20 reported feature names belong to the reference set; this set-membership requirement cannot be expressed through the non-ID column configuration. Exclude candidate-only Rank and Pearson_r_with_Age because they are not required outputs for comparison. Allow column naming and order differences through alignment. Apply the 10% relative error limit to every matched feature; an averaged match score alone must not conceal individual failures.
